\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb,amsthm}
\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\newcommand{\lean}[1]{}

\title{Bounds Sharper Than Their Statements}
\author{A synthetic example}
\date{}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

\begin{lemma}\label{lem:sharp}\lean{Facts.bound}
Let $x$, $C$ and $h$ be integers with $C \ge 0$, $h \ge 0$ and $x + 1 \le C h$. Then
$x \le C h$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:cases}\lean{Facts.bound_cases}
Let $x$, $C$ and $h$ be integers with $C \ge 0$ and $x + 1 \le C h$. If $h \ge 0$ then
$x \le 2 C h$.
\end{theorem}

\end{document}
